clue.text: Leaves boat renovated by Carnegie's first company

clue.text: Penguin feather was stuck in dandy's cap to attain this style

clue.text: Military vehicle and a Royal Marine alongside remote university racecourse

clue.text: Title of manuscript about the start of Romanticism

clue.text: On giving up love and gold, French police inspector is ascetic

clue.text: Jam produced by monk according to the Reverend's pronouncement

clue.text: Bashed part of building — a column?
